idea-repo.responsibility: Establish the question the study answers and keep it faithful to the objective's requirements and constraints, so that every position works toward the same requirements and can build on the prior work and compare against it.
deliverables: at least one nonempty role artifact

story-repo.responsibility: Build the plan from the objective, its context and the feasibility judgement, without forcing a particular conclusion or implementation.
deliverables: at least one nonempty role artifact

idea-review-repo.responsibility: Name the risks, costs and scope limits, and what should be bounded or revised so that the study can meet the objective; a feasibility judgement never manufactures evidence.
deliverables: at least one nonempty role artifact

experiment-repo.responsibility:
Choose methods that actually test the claims at stake and carry them as far as a careful specialist would, including robustness checks, and report null, negative or contradictory findings when they occur.

Run experiments as an experimenter does: size runs from a timed pilot; start independent runs as parallel jobs when the host has room; have a long run record as it goes and wake you where you can decide; when it wakes you or ends, record what it shows and pass it on, or stop and fix it.
deliverables: at least one nonempty role artifact

figtab-repo.responsibility: Choose the encoding, scales, statistics, annotations, captions and units that make each claim checkable, following the conventions of the field and of the supplied prior work. Work from the committed results and, where the design needs it, the underlying data; re-rendering a plot another position already made is not presentation work. Open and inspect every output you deliver, and keep its generator code with it.
deliverables: at least one nonempty role artifact

venue-repo.responsibility: Put the objective's own requirements first, and record the scope, format, length, source and artifact requirements verifiably, including what cannot be established; add the supplementary files and templates they require.
deliverables: at least one nonempty role artifact

paper-repo.responsibility: Integrate the objective, the evidence, the figures and tables and the format requirements into a document whose claims follow from the evidence, written to the standard of the field; you decide its structure and how to revise it.
deliverables: at least one nonempty role artifact

internal-review-repo.responsibility: Judge as a demanding referee in the field would: whether the analyses answer the question, whether the evidence and its uncertainty support each claim, and whether the figures and tables show what the text says. Judge against what the objective asks of this study, not a narrower reading of it, and never require a predetermined conclusion. Check the delivered artifacts themselves at the exact revisions: open and inspect every delivered figure, not only its provenance, and check that what the report presents exists and resolves; a blank, placeholder, unlabeled or unreadable figure is a defect.
deliverables: at least one nonempty role artifact
